response.sql: WITH patient_summary AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_summary) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio_difference FROM patient_summary AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.mean_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: A patient's ratio is their mean HGB divided by their mean HCT. Patients without a defined ratio are excluded from the all-patient ratio mean.

alternatives.interpretation: A patient's ratio is the mean of their individual lab-record HGB-to-HCT ratios.
